# Gaurav Sharma — Filmmaker

> Narrative shorts, brand films and animation by Gaurav Sharma.

## Work

- [The Architect Who Built for the Soul (2026, Documentary, 1:31)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-the-architect-who-built-for-the-soul): A tribute to a master of humane Indian modernism — the architect who believed a house is not shelter but a precious thing.
- [The Beaver Who Had No Crown (2026, Animation, 1:07)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-the-beaver-who-had-no-crown): Pip is the only beaver in the colony without a crown, and too afraid to jump off the great dam to earn one.
- [Trapped Alone in Space (2026, Trailer, 0:11)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-trapped-alone-in-space): A scientist, a dying ship, no way home. When contact with Earth goes silent, he has to decide what is worth surviving for.
- [A Boy Drew His Dream on a Ball (2026, Animation, 1:18)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-a-boy-drew-his-dream-on-a-ball): A boy in a small Indian backyard chalks the number 7 onto a rag ball and plays a World Cup final that only exists in his head.
- [The Strike (2026, Animation, 1:47)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-the-strike): Under a full moon, the Nighthawk unit crosses an unnamed frontier for a surgical-strike mission deep in enemy territory.
- [The Rakhi That Never Breaks (2026, Animation, 1:19)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-the-rakhi-that-never-breaks): Every year the thread fades. This Raksha Bandhan, one sister decides to give her brother something that will not.
- [He Tried to Escape His Fear (2026, Animation, 1:01)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-he-tried-to-escape-his-fear): One man tries to outrun the thing he has been avoiding his whole life, and finds out what happens when hiding stops working.
- [Sonam Wangchuk: The Boy the System Failed (2026, Documentary, 1:05)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-sonam-wangchuk): He could not understand the language at school. His teachers called him slow. They were wrong.
- [The Lunchbox That Kept Coming Back (2026, Animation, 1:52)](https://argaurshar.github.io/aifilmmaking-portfolio/work.html#film-the-lunchbox-that-kept-coming-back): Ramesh has delivered the same red tiffin to the same desk every day for years. Then one day it comes back untouched.

## Services

- Narrative short: A story with a beginning and an end, usually one to five minutes.
- Brand film: A film for a product or a company that is watchable on its own.
- Animation: Moving image work that is not shot — sequences, titles, transitions, whole pieces.
